title: WALL-E, the little clean-up robot.
lines: Far in the future the Earth is full of rubbish.
There are mountains of junk everywhere.
The people have left in a big spaceship.
A little square robot with big eyes like binoculars.
He pushes it into his tummy.
He turns it into little blocks.
He stacks the blocks on top of each other.
That's how he makes towers as tall as skyscrapers.
He watches the film every evening.
Two people dancing and holding hands.
He wants someone to hold hands with too.
One day WALL-E finds something special.
She's smooth and shiny and she can fly.
WALL-E falls in love straight away.
And then he shows her the little plant.
She puts it in her tummy.
She has to go back to the spaceship.
WALL-E doesn't want to lose her.
He jumps onto the rocket too.
On the spaceship the people have become very fat and lazy.
They sit in little chairs all day.
EVE gives the plant to the captain.
Something is growing on Earth again!
But the autopilot, an angry computer, doesn't want to go back.
He wants to throw the plant away.
WALL-E gets squashed, but he doesn't give up.
The captain stands up from his chair.
The ship goes back to Earth.
The people plant the little plant in the ground.
Together they clean up the Earth.
